title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 8 — WORLD 1: C1 ADVANCED COMMUNICATION GATEWAY

missions.title: Advanced Vocabulary Intelligence Lab
missions.focus: Build precise C1 vocabulary through collocations, register and contextual meaning.

missions.title: Precision & Nuance Decoder
missions.focus: Distinguish near-synonyms and select language according to degree, certainty and tone.

missions.title: Collocation Command Center
missions.focus: Master high-frequency academic and professional collocations in authentic contexts.

missions.title: Grammar: Aspect Mastery
missions.focus: Control perfect, continuous and perfect-continuous forms to express precise time relationships.

missions.title: Grammar: Inversion Protocol
missions.focus: Use negative and restrictive inversion for emphasis and sophisticated written communication.

missions.title: Grammar: Conditional Architect
missions.focus: Construct mixed and advanced conditional structures to analyse hypothetical situations.

missions.title: Reading: Argument Scanner
missions.focus: Identify claims, evidence, assumptions, counterarguments and implied conclusions in a complex text.

missions.title: Reading: Hidden Meaning Lab
missions.focus: Infer attitude, implication, bias and unstated meaning from advanced prose.

missions.title: Listening: Signal Hunter
missions.focus: Track key ideas, discourse markers, speaker stance and shifts in an extended recording.

missions.title: Listening: Fast Speech Challenge
missions.focus: Understand connected speech, reduced forms and reformulated ideas in natural English.

missions.title: Speaking: Strategic Response
missions.focus: Give structured responses that qualify claims, provide evidence and address alternatives.

missions.title: Speaking: Debate Arena
missions.focus: Defend a position, challenge assumptions and respond spontaneously to opposing arguments.

missions.title: Speaking: Executive Briefing
missions.focus: Deliver a concise professional briefing with clear priorities, evidence and recommendations.

missions.title: Writing: Cohesion Engine
missions.focus: Create coherent paragraphs using reference, substitution, linking and controlled repetition.

missions.title: Writing: Analytical Report
missions.focus: Write an evidence-based report with an introduction, findings, interpretation and conclusion.

missions.title: Writing: Persuasive Editorial
missions.focus: Develop a nuanced argument using counterclaims, concessions, evidence and a controlled register.

missions.title: Real-World Communication Lab
missions.focus: Solve a complex workplace or academic communication problem through spoken and written English.

missions.title: C1 Integrated Skills Quest
missions.focus: Combine advanced vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening, speaking and writing in one scenario.

missions.title: World 1 Master Challenge
missions.focus: Complete a multi-stage C1 challenge that tests precision, inference, argumentation and fluency.

missions.title: World 1 Gateway Boss
missions.focus: Demonstrate independent C1 communication across academic, professional and real-world tasks.

realWorldScenarios.title: International Project Meeting
realWorldScenarios.task: Present a proposal, handle objections and negotiate a practical next step.

realWorldScenarios.title: Academic Discussion
realWorldScenarios.task: Analyse a complex issue, cite evidence and respond to alternative interpretations.

realWorldScenarios.title: Professional Problem Solving
realWorldScenarios.task: Write a concise report and deliver a briefing about a developing situation.

assessment.mastery: Learner must demonstrate accurate, flexible and context-appropriate C1 communication.
